Sovereign Operator Surface

One portal. Two interconnected apps. Zero nonsense.

This package gives you a branded launcher surface for the mini suite. JWT Forge creates secrets, keypairs, env blocks, browser OpenSSL-style artifacts, and exports. Sovereign Variables stores, organizes, and mirrors variable material so users can move between both surfaces without losing the thread.
